previousRule: The scheduled customer journey workflow wrote logs and a generic GitHub issue, but did not publish authenticated pass and fail heartbeats into the private Customer Experience dashboard.
newRule: The scheduled workflow publishes a signed, bounded report to separate private synthetic storage. The dashboard distinguishes healthy, degraded, failed, stale and unknown monitor states, groups repeat findings, and marks recovery only after a passing check.
reason: The owner requested site-wide operational monitoring with coverage status, release attribution, no-consent technical fault diagnostics, and a monitored monitor while preserving consented visit analytics and existing commerce behaviour.
ownerApprovedDecision: This monitoring-only change is awaiting Nylon1's exact-current-head PR approval under release/policy-change.mjs. This policy record does not grant approval or permit deployment by itself.
